summary.id: Platform operasional UMKM: POS, inventory, kasbon, analytics, dan AI Assistant dalam satu sistem.
summary.en: SME operations platform: POS, inventory, debt tracking, analytics, and AI Assistant in one system.

problem.id: UMKM sering memakai banyak tools terpisah untuk kasir, stok, dan insight bisnis sehingga operasional lambat dan rawan selisih data.
problem.en: SMEs often use separate tools for cashier operations, stock tracking, and business insights, causing slow operations and data inconsistencies.

solution.id: Membangun sistem terintegrasi dengan alur transaksi, inventori batch/FIFO, pembayaran online, dan AI center berbasis data bisnis.
solution.en: Built an integrated system with transaction flow, batch/FIFO inventory, online payments, and an AI center grounded in business data.

summary.id: Platform persiapan karier berbasis AI untuk latihan interview teknis dan analisis CV ATS dalam satu aplikasi.
summary.en: An AI-powered career preparation platform that combines technical mock interviews and ATS-focused resume analysis in one app.

problem.id: Pencari kerja sering kesulitan latihan interview yang realistis, mendapatkan feedback CV yang actionable, dan memantau progres secara terstruktur.
problem.en: Job seekers often struggle to get realistic interview practice, actionable resume feedback, and structured progress tracking.

solution.id: Membangun aplikasi fullstack dengan mock interview adaptif, analisis resume PDF berbasis AI, dukungan voice (STT/TTS), gamification, serta monetisasi Pro melalui Midtrans.
solution.en: Built a fullstack app with adaptive AI mock interviews, PDF resume analysis, voice support (STT/TTS), gamification, and Pro monetization via Midtrans.

en: Implemented monetization flow with Midtrans and automatic Pro upgrade activation (IDR 50,000).
Enforced free-tier limits (max 1 interview session) while unlocking unlimited sessions for Pro users.
Delivered bilingual feedback output (English and Indonesian) for both interview evaluation and resume analysis.
Enabled voice-based interview flow using speech-to-text and text-to-speech endpoints.
id: Implemented monetization flow with Midtrans and automatic Pro upgrade activation (IDR 50,000).

summary.id: Dior Dungeon adalah game RPG multiplayer berbasis web (hingga 3 pemain) dengan dungeon, karakter, event NPC, dan narasi yang dihasilkan AI secara dinamis.
summary.en: Dior Dungeon is a browser-based multiplayer RPG (up to 3 players) with AI-generated dungeons, characters, NPC events, and dynamic narration.

problem.id: Game RPG tradisional sering statis, butuh instalasi, dan sulit dimainkan bareng secara cepat. Cerita juga repetitif sehingga replay value rendah.
problem.en: Traditional RPGs are often static, require installation, and are harder to play instantly with friends. Storylines also become repetitive, lowering replay value.

solution.id: Membangun game web realtime dengan Socket.IO, backend server-authoritative, dan integrasi Gemini/Groq untuk procedural generation dungeon, karakter, event NPC, serta narasi battle.
solution.en: Built a real-time web game using Socket.IO, a server-authoritative backend, and Gemini/Groq integration for procedural dungeon, character, NPC event, and battle narration generation.

en: Enabled instant party play (up to 3 players) directly from browser
Improved replayability with AI-generated dungeon and narrative variation
Reduced client-side cheating risk by keeping core game logic on server
Supported bilingual gameplay experience (Indonesian/English)
